name: R5 L2 P10-D (PPO)
description: Registered R5 L2 arm P10-D: the reference PPO entrant on us-ndx80 with the DeepSeek-V3 scores, same-day alignment (the authors' alignment) with sentiment/risk strength s=0.1; the checkpoint with the best 2018 validation Sharpe is tested on 2019-2023. trials = 14 (every registered L2 arm); the task is a survivorship-biased re-evaluation, not a ranked universe.
